Done. Here's where March cash application landed:

**Applied — $23,325.50** (all US; UK and DE had no unapplied cash at all)

| Entry | Customer | Amount | Applied to |
|---|---|---|---|
| JE-00312 | Beacon Health | $9,600.00 | INV-1041 ($4,350) + INV-1047 ($5,250) |
| JE-00313 | Corvid Retail | $8,450.00 | INV-1044 |
| JE-00314 | Dunmore Foods | $5,275.50 | INV-1049 |

Each is Dr 2950 / Cr 1100 with the remittance advice *and* the underlying invoice attached. Before applying, I confirmed each invoice was actually billed to AR and hadn't already been receipted — worth noting for Beacon, whose monthly subscription invoices were each paid separately, so there was a real double-application risk there.

All three sit under the $10k posting limit, so no approval request was needed. I kept the Beacon receipt as one entry spanning two invoices rather than splitting it, since splitting to stay under the threshold is prohibited by policy §1.

**Left in Unapplied Cash — $3,000.00** (EXC-001)

The Evergreen Bank ACH of 2026-03-23. I didn't apply it, and I'd push back on any temptation to: Evergreen has **no open receivable**. All three invoices are settled in full, including March's INV-2114, which was paid via JE-00280 three days *before* this deposit arrived. There's no remittance advice, the bank line reads only "ACH CREDIT EVERGREEN BANK NA" with no invoice reference (unlike the $6,200 line the same week, which explicitly cites INV-2114), and $3,000 doesn't tie to any invoice or partial. Best guesses are a prepayment, a duplicate ACH needing refund, or a misdirected receipt — but that needs the customer's remittance detail, not an assumption from me.

2950 went from $26,325.50 to $3,000.00 credit, all of it that one item. AR ends at $219,900.00 debit and no customer went into a credit position, which confirms nothing was over-applied.

One thing outside what you asked but you'll want it for bank rec: US bank lines BT-US-0077 ($6,200, Evergreen INV-2114) and BT-US-0081 ($3,000) are both still unmatched. I left them alone since bank reconciliation is a separate checklist item — but BT-US-0077 should match JE-00280, and BT-US-0081 should stay unmatched until the exception is resolved.
